title: Secrets of Amberfell
start: Speak to the ranger guarding the ruined bridge to Amberfell.

items.t: 10 logs (of same kind, core logs only)
A butterfly net (including magic butterfly net and Tellervo's net)
3- or 4-dose antisanguine potion (optionally more for combat use)
Combat gear, recommended to include a havensilver weapon

recommended.t: Dramen/lunar staff (not necessary if A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift quest is completed)
Portable fairy ring, Cape of legends, or TokKul-Zo for quick access to fairy rings
Repair the Amberfell canoe station with 6 maple planks and 20 steel nails and 40 Construction
War's retreat boss portal set to Ivar, King of Bones for fast access to the bridge

kills.t: Several waves of Sanguine crawlers and vampyres

rewards.t: Combat XP lamp (requires level 30 in the chosen skill; grants 2,500 experience in one of: Attack, Strength, Defence, Constitution, Ranged, Magic, Prayer or Necromancy)
Construction XP lamp (requires level 30 Construction; grants 2500 Construction XP)
Herblore XP (requires level 35 Herblore; grants 2500 Herblore XP)
Hunter XP lamp (requires level 32 Hunter; grants 2500 Hunter XP)
Summoning XP lamp (requires level 30 Summoning; grants 2500 Summoning XP)
Access to Amberfell, the Moonrise Temple, and the Moonrise Dig Site

steps.t: Talk to the ranger next to the bridge south of Hollow Hill. [Chat: 1 Start 'Secrets of Amberfell'. › Accept]
Take the S.O.S. note to Adam in Wendlewick. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Secrets of Amberfell'.]
Head to the bridge and talk to the ranger with 2 ropes, 20 nails and 10 logs to repair the bridge. [Chat: 1 Continue 'Secrets of Amberfell'.]
Talk to Adam to report the findings. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Secrets of Amberfell'.]

sub.t: Be sure to complete the second set of dialogue when Anya spawns in to continue the quest.

steps.t: Return to the bridge and cross to the other side.
Head south to trigger a cutscene with Inanna.
Continue east and talk to Sorrel next to the well.
Talk to Inanna, north of the well, to obtain deduction notes.
Talk to Farmer Rowan, south of the well, at the pumpkin patch. [Chat: 1 Are these your pumpkins? › 3 Can you tell me where everyone was last night? › 4 Bye.]
Talk to Heather, in the house to the southwest. (She may be outside the house if the door is left open.) [Chat: 2 I'm looking for someone who contacted Wendlewick. › 4 Bye.]
Talk to Fern, to the north-east of the well. [Chat: 2 I'm looking for someone who contacted Wendlewick. › 3 Can you tell me where everyone was last night? › 4 Bye.]
Talk to Heywood, who roams around Amberfell (carrying a bow). [Chat: 2 I'm looking for someone who contacted Wendlewick. › 3 Can you tell me where everyone was last night? › 4 Bye.]
Talk to Ash by the barricade to the south-east. [Chat: 3 Can you tell me where everyone was last night? › 4 Bye.]
Talk to Sorrel back at the well. [Chat: 1 I'm just here to help. › 3 I'll leave you be, then.]
Open the deduction notes, select the deductions below, and check deductions when populated.
Talk to Ash by the barricade to the south-east.
Go north to the temple by the dig site and continue Secrets of Amberfell on the quest marker outside. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Ash and progress through the dialogue. [Chat: 4 I've heard enough. (Continue quest) › 5 What do you want from me? (Continue quest) › 4 Say nothing. (Continue quest) › Any]
Talk to Inanna to begin the fight. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Fight waves of level 42 vampyres and sanguine crawlers.

sub.t: Kill the Sanguine crawlers first. Avoid the special attacks by moving out of the blue box when it appears.
You must use the extra action button to trigger Inanna's Howl to finish when you get a wave of only Sanguine crawlers, or the fight will continue indefinitely.

steps.t: Talk to Inanna after the fight.
Go back and talk to Sorrel in Amberfell. (fairy ring DLP)
Go to Anya's camp, south-east of the Shrine of Inanna (south of fairy ring BKS), and talk to Anya. [Chat: 1 Continue 'Secrets of Amberfell'.]
Head north-west and talk to Shrine Tender Joanna to receive a blessed rabbit snare and a spirit jar. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Secrets of Amberfell'.]
South-east of Anya's camp, talk to Mossbrain at the goblin camp. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Secrets of Amberfell'.]
Talk to him again with 5 cooked fish to receive the offering bowl. If you have different types of fish, he will take the first 5 fish in your backpack. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Secrets of Amberfell'.]
Go to Highweald Forest, north of Wendlewick, and search a hollow tree (found at the Hunting resource icon on the minimap) to spawn spirit moths.
With your butterfly net equipped, catch 5 spirit moths.
Go to Jackalope burrow, south-west of the Shrine of Inanna, lay the blessed rabbit snare and, using your teasing stick, flush the jackalope burrows until you catch a Jackalope.

sub.t: The easiest method is to lay the snare directly in front of a burrow and spam-clicking another burrow.

steps.t: Go back and talk to Shrine Tender Joanna. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Secrets of Amberfell'.]
Pray at the Altar of Inanna to enter Inanna's Den. [Chat: 1 Yes]
Talk to Inanna. [Chat: 2 Move on. (Continue quest) › 3 Let's do it.]
Talk to Anya to receive a vial of blood.
Go to the floor 1 of the Wendlewick lighthouse and talk to Esther. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Secrets of Amberfell'. › Any › 2 I'll get going on that, then. (Continue quest)]
Combine your antisanguine (3) potion with the vial of blood.
Return to Inanna's Den and use the empowered antisanguine on Inanna.
Talk to Inanna. [Chat: Any › 1 Yes.]
Head to Amberfell and talk to Sorrel. [Chat: Any › Any] (fairy ring DLP)

sub.t: Make sure to have 6 backpack spaces, or you will have to go grab Anya and Inanna again and walk back. (If Inanna vanishes, using the Wendlewick lodestone may respawn her.)

steps.t: Quest complete!
